digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause ownership
propositions: The bridge runner must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint without requiring repository-local runner scripts.
Legacy reconcile vocabulary, checked-out workflows invoking rebar reconcile --mode, and published defaults/exit codes must retain their behavior after bridge portability is implemented.
Destructive-repair schedule safety (fsck --repair and doctor --repair) must be owned by a provider-neutral durable gate mechanism using git refs, with no GitHub CLI dependency.

The pause mechanism must read the existing pause snapshot, call set_pause, and clear only its observed OID through the gate ref, enforcing per-invocation repair identity tokens and foreign-pause abort semantics.
Local and GitHub/Jenkins/GitLab CI callers must all invoke exactly rebar bridge run through the packaged Python core in src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py.
Test coverage must prove the no-GitHub-CLI contract by intercepting subprocess calls beginning with gh, running destructive repair successfully, and asserting zero GitHub CLI invocations.
